home.title: MCP servers for any website
home.subtitle: raidr crawls a site, reads the JavaScript it ships, and turns the APIs it calls into a hosted MCP server plus an agent skill that explains how to get a token. Bring your own login; the tools do the rest.
home.how1: Pick an API host. Its page lists every tool and the request each one makes.
home.how2: Open the matching skill to see exactly where to copy your token from after logging in to the site.
home.how3: Add the endpoint to your MCP client with the token in the X-Raidr-Token header.

mcps.title: MCP servers
mcps.subtitle: One hosted MCP server per API host, generated from observed traffic.

mcp.skillTitle: A skill explains how to get a token for this API

connect.intro: Add the hosted endpoint to your MCP client with two headers: your raidr API key, and your own token for the site. raidr forwards the site token to the upstream API on every call and never stores either.
connect.noAuth: This API needs no site token.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: One SKILL.md per API host: what it does, how to log in and grab a token, and how to connect the MCP server.

skill.installOne: Run this once, then start a new Claude Code session. The first time the skill runs it asks for your raidr API key and saves it to ~/.raidr/config.json.
